name: IHOP 55+ Menu
description: Special 55+ menu with value pricing on IHOP favorites
fullDescription: IHOP offers a 55+ menu featuring smaller portions of popular items at reduced prices. Available at participating locations for guests aged 55 and older.
whatTheyOffer:
- 55+ menu with value pricing on all-day IHOP favorites
- Options include a breakfast sampler, French toast, and crispy shrimp or fish
- Available all day
- No coupon or membership required
howToGetIt:
1. Visit a participating IHOP location
2. Ask for the 55+ menu (ages 55 and older)
3. Prices and availability may vary by location
keywords: IHOP, senior discount, 55+, senior menu, restaurant, breakfast, pancakes, affordable meals
